<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Integrate Phase 1’s file-cell contract without teaching ordinary files to pretend to be ddocs. Existing files are resolved terminal nodes, missing files are unresolved warnings, and neither is traversed. Structured paths render relative to the sibling; literal Markdown keeps its own href. Build aggregates the same file findings into degraded exit-0 envelopes. Finish with independent mutation proof, the exact targeted suites, `ddocs status`, and `just checks`.
